newsitem.title: USA: Glenway to buy back up to 5 pct of shrs.
newsitem.headline: Glenway to buy back up to 5 pct of shrs.

text.p: Glenway Financial Corp said Wednesday it plans to buy back up to five percent of its outstanding common shares in the over-the-counter market over the next months.
The number of shares to be purchased and the price to be paid will depend on the availability of shares and the prevailing market prices, it said.
As of February 1, Glenway had 1,159,769 shares outstanding.
The repurchased shares are expected to be retained as treasury shares to be held for future issuance under the company's stock option plan.
